_comment: Copy this object into settings.json under pre_optimization, or POST {pre_optimization: <this object>} to /api/settings. _comment fields are ignored. enabled toggles rule evaluation. timeout_ms is a cooperative local evaluation deadline. latency_budget_ms and cost_budget_usd cap estimated optimizer-call latency and total cost; null removes a cap. Tighter request budgets win. Model IDs must exist at optimizer.url.

disabled._comment: When enabled=false: true requests optimization with this model; false skips. Existing eligibility checks and optimizer.enabled still apply. Budgets always apply.

fallback._comment: Evaluation exceptions, deadline expiry, or invalid decisions use this policy. false preserves the original prompt. Invalid configuration itself always skips.

criteria._comment: All populated conditions must match. Minimums are inclusive. Complexity counts distinct case-insensitive keyword substring matches. Empty category/tier lists allow all values; nonempty lists require matching request metadata.

gemini-3.8-flash-high._comment: Illustrative estimates per optimization call, not provider prices or measurements. Replace with your observed latency and expected total input/output cost.

gpt-6-sol._comment: Example coding specialist; must be served by the same configured optimizer endpoint and credentials.

routing_rules._comment: First matching affordable rule wins. At least two complexity keywords select the coding specialist.
Catch-all for eligible prompts; also used if the specialist exceeds a request budget. Remove to skip unmatched prompts.
